name: JW Broadcasting
description: Browse and stream public JW.ORG videos as a Jellyfin Channel via JW Broadcasting.
overview: Adds a JW.ORG Channel to Jellyfin. The plugin browses public JW.ORG video categories and streams selected MP4 files directly from JW CDN URLs without downloading media locally.

versions.changelog:
Two root causes found and fixed:
1. HydrateMediaAsync only called GetMediaItemAsync when Files.Count == 0.
   Items that arrived from the category listing with files but without image
   data were never re-fetched, so the null image propagated to Jellyfin.
   Now also fetches the full detail record when ImageUrl is null.
2. ExtractImageUrl silently returned null for JSON arrays. Older JW.ORG API
   responses can return thumbnail as [{url, width, height}, ...]. Added an
   array branch that picks the first url property.
DataVersion bumped to 7 to force Jellyfin to re-index all channel items
and pick up correct image URLs. Users should also clear the image cache
via Admin → Dashboard → Troubleshooting → Clean image cache.

v0.2.3 restructured the language root but forgot to bump DataVersion,
so Jellyfin kept serving cached items from the old layout.

When a user navigates into a language (or the root with a single language),
instead of showing the 6 top-level API categories (Audio, Featured×3,
Latest Videos, Video Categories), now shows:
  1. Audio
  2. Latest Videos (Neueste Videos)
  3-16. All 14 VideoOnDemand sub-categories (Die Bibel, Familie, Musik, …)
Featured / Empfehlungen folders are hidden as they have no image and
add no value over the direct category listing.
Audio and VideoOnDemand sub-categories are fetched in parallel.
DataVersion bumped to 6 to force a full re-index.

Declaring ImageType.Backdrop caused Jellyfin to use the channel banner
as a fallback tile image for categories/folders that have no image from
the JW.ORG API (Featured, language folders). It was cropped to a square
and looked broken. Removing Backdrop lets Jellyfin show its own neutral
placeholder for imageless items instead.

- Redesign logo.png 256x256: remove circle, full-bleed dark navy
  gradient matching banner style, signal arcs + JW + Broadcasting text
- Add thumbnail.png 800x400: purpose-built plugin catalog tile image
  same dark navy gradient + broadcast waves + JW Broadcasting title
- Update imageUrl in manifest.json to point to thumbnail.png
- Embed thumbnail.png in assembly

- Add imageUrl to manifest.json pointing to logo.png on GitHub raw:
  Jellyfin downloads this when installing and shows it in Admin→Plugins
  instead of the default puzzle piece
- Bump DataVersion 4→5 to force Jellyfin to re-index the channel and
  refresh the cached channel logo on the home screen

- Redesign logo.png: replace tower drawing (looked like a Chinese
  character) with clear signal arcs + bold "JW Broadcasting" text
  on a dark navy circle
- Add thumb.png embedded as Jellyfin.Plugin.JwOrg.thumb.png so
  Jellyfin serves it at /Plugins/{guid}/Image (plugin catalog page)

Logo was 256 KB (RGBA), banner was 3.5 MB (RGBA) — both caused display
failures in Jellyfin. Replaced with RGB PNGs: logo 2 KB, banner 30 KB.

Pull --rebase before pushing the manifest commit back to main so the
stable release job doesn't fail when the branch has moved ahead during
the build.

- Use languageAgnosticNaturalKey as the media item key: the media-items
  API requires pub-jwb-137_1_VIDEO not pub-jwb-137_E_1_VIDEO (with the
  embedded language code) — the language-specific naturalKey always
  returned an empty response, breaking all playback via the callback
- Add audio/MP3 support: new IsAudioFile() filter, audio MediaStream,
  mp3 container, ChannelMediaType.Audio / ChannelMediaContentType.Song
  so the Audio category and its subcategories play correctly
- Add MediaType field to JwOrgMediaItem (default: "video") read from
  the API "type" field to distinguish audio from video items
- Declare Audio and Song in InternalChannelFeatures
- DataVersion 4 to force re-index after key format change

Update MapCategoryIncludesSubcategoriesAndPlayableMedia to assert
empty MediaSources (now populated via callback only) and correct item id.
Add MapMediaSourcesSelectsHighestQualityWithinLimit test for the new
MapMediaSources method.

- Pipeline now passes -p:Version from the git tag so the DLL assembly
  version matches the release (e.g. 0.1.4.0 instead of always 0.1.0.0)
- Implement IRequiresMediaInfoCallback so Jellyfin fetches live media
  sources at play time instead of using stale cached database values
- Fix ReadImageUrl to resolve nested size-variant objects (lg/md/sm)
  from the JW.ORG images API — thumbnails were always returning null
- Bump DataVersion to 2 to force re-index of all channel items so
  fixed metadata and images are picked up immediately after upgrade
- Add Studios and OfficialRating fields to video detail pages

- Add MediaStreams (h264/aac) to MediaSourceInfo so Jellyfin can
  approve direct play on all clients including iOS
- Remove non-MP4 fallback in SelectFile so only playable formats
  are offered
- Sort media items by date descending (newest first) within categories
- Declare DefaultSortFields so clients can toggle sort order
- Language folders now show vernacular name (e.g. Deutsch, English)
  instead of raw code (D, E), fetched from JW.ORG API and cached 24h
- Skip language folder entirely when only one language is configured,
  opening directly to categories

Microsoft.Extensions.Http was being bundled in the plugin zip,
conflicting with the server's own copies and breaking type identity
for IServiceCollection. Mark it PrivateAssets="all" so it is
compile-time only and the server-provided assembly is used at runtime.

Replace the comma-separated text field with a searchable dropdown
backed by the JW.ORG languages API (1,095 languages). Selected
languages appear as removable chips. Falls back gracefully to
manual code entry if the API is unreachable.
Initial release. Adds a JW.ORG Channel to Jellyfin for browsing and streaming public JW.ORG video content with multi-language support.
